Simultaneously, real-time tracking data (e.g., Kyren Williams’ RYOE = 40.8) provides ground-truth efficiency adjustments that refine these projections dynamically. The failure mode occurs when cognitive signals contradict physical metrics without proper reconciliation, leading to overfitting or misalignment in predictive models.
